listen.explanationKey: What is the capital of the United States?
facts: The capital of the United States is Washington, D.C. Congress, the President and the Supreme Court are there.
The Statue of Liberty is in New York Harbor, on Liberty Island, near New York City.
The United States is between Canada to the north and Mexico to the south.

the home and office of the President
